summary: EIP-8430（从 EIP-8130 拆出的 AA 交易类型，支持批量调用、gas 赞助、2D nonce 和内置 7702 式委托）与 EIP-8477（让 EIP-7702 授权绑定最近 256 个区块之一）作为草案合并进 EIPs 仓库。EF 博客发布 PQAI #0，把后量子和后 AI 的密码学迁移列为最高优先级，用户账户要迁到基于哈希的签名。ACDT #104 上多数人倾向不改 EIP-8037 规范，Bogota Devnet 3 和 Frame 交易如何支持 leanSPHINCS 推迟到下周继续讨论。

items.title: EIP-8430 AA Transaction Type 合并为草案
items.note: 2026-11-23 14:56（chunter-cb）。PR 描述列出的能力：分阶段的批量调用（调用可带原生 ETH）；gas 赞助，分绑定和开放两种付款方模式；2D nonce（key 0 就是账户 nonce）和免 nonce 模式；交易内置 EIP-7702 式代码委托（account_changes 类型 0x01）。认证器选择器、actor 解析钩子和预留的 account-change 类型，让其他账户模型不用新交易类型就能接入；EIP-8130（Keystore Accounts）在 PR #12386 里定义了其中一种接入。讨论帖。
items.title_en: EIP-8430 AA Transaction Type was merged as a draft
items.note_en: On 2026-11-23 at 14:56 (chunter-cb). The PR lists phased call batching (calls can carry native ETH); gas sponsorship with bound and open payer modes; 2D nonces (key 0 is the account nonce) and a nonce-free mode; and in-band EIP-7702-style code delegation (account_changes type 0x01). An authenticator selector, an actor-resolution hook and reserved account-change types let other account models plug in without a new transaction type; EIP-8130 (Keystore Accounts) specifies one such integration in PR #12386. Discussion thread.

items.title: PR #12708：EIP-8141 只允许 VERIFY 帧读取签名哈希之外的签名字节
items.note: 2026-11-23 21:00（soispoke）。对 msg 为空的 ARBITRARY 条目，签名哈希只覆盖其长度，转发交易的任何人都能改这些字节，而目前任何帧里的代码都能复制它们。改动后在 VERIFY 帧之外调用 SIGDATACOPY 读这类条目会直接停止，对签名哈希做的自定义见证检查必须放在 VERIFY 帧里。
items.title_en: PR #12708: EIP-8141 lets only VERIFY frames read signature bytes outside the signature hash
items.note_en: 2026-11-23 21:00 (soispoke). For an ARBITRARY entry with an empty msg, the signature hash covers only its length, so anyone relaying the transaction can change those bytes, and today code in any frame can copy them. With the change, SIGDATACOPY on such an entry halts outside a VERIFY frame, so any custom witness check over the signature hash has to run in a VERIFY frame.

items.title_en: PR #12672: EIP-8504 supports leanSPHINCS signatures through dependency frames
items.note_en: Updated 2026-11-23 23:03 (ilitteri). items.title: EIP-8477 Recent Block Bound Delegation Authorizations 合并为草案
items.note: 2026-11-23 14:59（dangerousfood）。动机：未使用的 EIP-7702 授权在协议上没有有效期，只要账户 nonce 对得上就能随时被使用。方案扩展 type 0x04 的授权格式，要求签入执行层区块号和区块头哈希，只有该区块是包含区块前 256 个祖先之一时才能应用；保留 0x05 签名前缀，激活后拒绝旧的无锚定授权；授权列表的处理语义不变，也不会让已安装的委托失效。讨论帖。
items.title_en: EIP-8477 Recent Block Bound Delegation Authorizations was merged as a draft
items.note_en: On 2026-11-23 at 14:59 (dangerousfood). The motivation: unused EIP-7702 authorizations have no protocol-enforced freshness bound and stay usable whenever the account nonce matches. The proposal extends the type 0x04 authorization format so it signs an execution block number and header hash, and allows it only while that block is one of the inclusion block's 256 preceding ancestors. It keeps the 0x05 signing prefix, rejects legacy unanchored authorizations after activation, leaves authorization-list processing unchanged and does not expire installed delegations. Discussion thread.

items.title: Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts 发布 Registry v2
items.note: 2026-11-24 03:21（palisec-dev）：按评审意见，发布者提交的每个策略都要经 setPending 并至少提前账户设定的 minDelay，只有账户自己能立即激活；注册表部署在 Robinhood Chain（4663），无 owner、不可升级，客户端库 0.2.0 已上 npm。此前 palisec-dev 回复 Secrypta（2026-11-23 14:39）同意在安全考虑里写明，策略承诺只覆盖需要策略签名者的操作，读者还要另外检查 allowance 和 permit、operator 授权、已安装模块和 executor、guard 和 hook、fallback handler，以及 ERC-7702 委托目标。Secrypta 建议（2026-11-23 16:39）把这些“出资面”快照做成独立的配套 ERC，因为快照只在拍摄的区块准确。
items.title_en: Policy-Enforced Agent Accounts shipped Registry v2
items.note_en: On 2026-11-24 at 03:21 (palisec-dev). Following review, every policy the publisher posts now goes through setPending at least the account's minDelay ahead, and only the account itself can activate immediately. The registry is deployed on Robinhood Chain (4663) with no owner and no upgrade path, and client library 0.2.0 is on npm. Earlier, palisec-dev replied to Secrypta (2026-11-23 14:39) agreeing that Security Considerations will state that a commitment only covers actions needing the policy signer, and that readers must separately check allowances and permits, operator approvals, installed modules and executors, guards and hooks, fallback handlers, and the ERC-7702 delegation target. Secrypta suggested (2026-11-23 16:39) making a snapshot of that fund-moving surface a separate companion ERC, since a snapshot is only accurate at the block it is taken.

items.topic: Gas 重新定价与后量子优先级：ACDT #104 和 PQAI #0
items.title: ACDT #104
items.note: 2026-11-23 举行，议程第一项是 Glamsterdam 的 EIP-8037/EIP-8038 团队反馈。按会议总结：Rahul（EF）汇总了各团队意见，Uniswap、Snowbridge、CoW Swap、Safe 等关注 try-catch 模式被打破和 gasleft 不变量，多数高中危问题预计在 1 月中旬前处理；Toni Wahrstätter 展示了 EIP-8037 可能的规范修改决策树，Maria Silva 解释去掉 reservoir 机制需要大幅提高交易上限并影响并行化；多数人倾向暂不改规范，最终决定在下次 ACD。Bogota Devnet 3 是否要做意见不一，推迟到下周。
items.note_en: Met on 2026-11-23, opening with team feedback on Glamsterdam's EIP-8037/EIP-8038. Per the meeting summary, Rahul (EF) collected feedback from teams: Uniswap, Snowbridge, CoW Swap, Safe and others are concerned about the try-catch pattern breaking and about the gasleft invariant, and most high and medium severity issues are expected to be addressed by mid-January. Toni Wahrstätter walked through a decision tree of possible EIP-8037 spec changes, and Maria Silva explained that dropping the reservoir mechanism would require a much higher transaction limit and would hurt parallelization. Most leaned toward not changing the spec for now, with the final decision at the next ACD. Opinions on whether to run Bogota Devnet 3 were split, and that was pushed to next week.

items.title: EIP-8487 Separate execution credits and billing credits
items.note: 2026-11-23 14:59 更新（Giulio2002）：用同一个 tx.gasLimit 初始化两个计数器，credits 沿用旧的 gas 表，管 EVM 可见的执行额度；billing 用新表，决定手续费；billing 不足时整笔交易不可捕获地中止。这是让重新定价不打破合约 gas 假设的一种思路。
items.title_en: EIP-8487 Separate execution credits and billing credits
items.note_en: Updated 2026-11-23 14:59 (Giulio2002): two counters start from the same tx.gasLimit. Credits use the legacy schedule and govern EVM-visible execution allowances, billing uses the new schedule and sets the fee, and running out of billing aborts the whole transaction uncatchably. It is one way to reprice without breaking contracts' gas assumptions.

items.title: 新草案 Bounded Storage Credit and Debit
items.note: 2026-11-23 19:18（cskiraly），作为停滞的 EIP-7519 的继任：SCREDIT 和 SDEBIT 在存储槽值处于上下界内时加减，按 SSTORE 计费，上界可服务 USDC 这类在余额字最高位放黑名单标志的布局。讨论帖。
items.title_en: New draft: Bounded Storage Credit and Debit
items.note_en: 2026-11-23 19:18 (cskiraly), a successor to the stagnant EIP-7519. SCREDIT and SDEBIT add to or subtract from a storage slot only if its value stays within lower and upper bounds, charged like SSTORE; the upper bound serves layouts like USDC's, which keeps a blacklist flag in the top bit of each balance word. Discussion thread.

items.note: 新草案 Bounded Storage Credit and Debit 2026-11-23 19:18（cskiraly），作为停滞的 EIP-7519 的继任：SCREDIT 和 SDEBIT 在存储槽值处于上下界内时加减，按 SSTORE 计费，上界可服务 USDC 这类在余额字最高位放黑名单标志的布局。讨论帖。
items.note_en: New draft: Bounded Storage Credit and Debit, 2026-11-23 19:18 (cskiraly), a successor to the stagnant EIP-7519. SCREDIT and SDEBIT add to or subtract from a storage slot only if its value stays within lower and upper bounds, charged like SSTORE; the upper bound serves layouts like USDC's, which keeps a blacklist flag in the top bit of each balance word. Discussion thread.

items.title: EF 博客 PQAI #0
items.note: 2026-11-23：EF 评估候选签名方案一年多后，主张用基于哈希的密码学替代椭圆曲线；三部分为共识（验证者用哈希签名）、用户账户（钱包提供迁到哈希签名的路径）、数据（blob 改用基于哈希的承诺）。文中写到 Justin Drake 在 Devcon 提出 2028 年 12 月的目标，EF 内部截止仍是 2029 年，1 月复审；Ethlabs 把自己的 Quick Slots 提案撤出 Hegotá 以腾出工程资源，EF 协议安全团队规模翻倍；剩余的 ACD 会议还会讨论从分叉中再拿掉哪些功能。@ethereumfndn 转发（2026-11-24 06:40）。
items.note_en: 2026-11-23: after more than a year of evaluating candidate signature schemes, the EF is advocating hash-based cryptography to replace elliptic curves. The three parts are consensus (validators sign with hash-based keys), user accounts (wallets give users a way to move to hash-based signatures) and data (blobs switch to hash-based commitments). The post notes Justin Drake proposed December 2028 as a target at Devcon, with 2029 still the EF's internal deadline and a review in January; Ethlabs pulled its own Quick Slots proposal out of Hegotá to free up engineering time, and the EF doubled its protocol security team. The remaining ACD calls this year will discuss what else to drop from the fork. Shared by @ethereumfndn (2026-11-24 06:40).

items.title: EIP-8513 Pre-seeded Encrypted Execution Payloads
items.note: 2026-11-23 15:37（cskiraly）：ePBS 下构建者在出价被区块包含后就先发加密负载，揭示时只发 32 字节密钥，缩短负载传播时间。cskiraly 在 ethresear.ch 回复（2026-11-23 16:12）：Gloas 对缺失负载没有出价之外的保证金或罚没，预发也不增加；密文上限约 12 MB。
items.note_en: 2026-11-23 15:37 (cskiraly): under ePBS the builder sends the payload encrypted as soon as its bid is included in a block, and the reveal becomes a 32-byte key, cutting payload propagation time. cskiraly replied on ethresear.ch (2026-11-23 16:12) that Gloas has no bond or slashing for a missing payload beyond the bid, pre-seeding adds none, and the ciphertext is capped at about 12 MB.

items.title: Aztec 介绍 Nyx
items.note: 隐私：Aztec 介绍 Nyx（2026-11-24 00:12），用现有以太坊钱包（含 Rabby）私密收付、在 Aave 赚息，再退出到以太坊且出口与入口无关联，已在 Aztec Tierra 上线；recmo 展示实用见证加密（2026-11-24 00:13），用 ZKPassport 和 Noir 电路可以把消息或资金“加密给某个名字”。
items.note_en: Privacy: Aztec introduced Nyx (2026-11-24 00:12), which lets you send and receive privately from the Ethereum wallet you already use (Rabby included), earn on Aave, then exit to Ethereum with nothing tying the exit to the entry; it is live on Aztec Tierra. recmo showed practical witness encryption (2026-11-24 00:13): with ZKPassport and a Noir circuit you can encrypt a message or send money to someone's name.

summary_en: EIP-8430 (an AA transaction type split out of EIP-8130, with call batching, gas sponsorship, 2D nonces and built-in 7702-style delegation) and EIP-8477 (which binds each EIP-7702 authorization to one of the last 256 blocks) were merged into the EIPs repo as drafts. The EF blog published PQAI #0, making the post-quantum, post-AI cryptography migration its top priority, with user accounts moving to hash-based signatures. At ACDT #104 most participants leaned toward leaving the EIP-8037 spec as it is, while Bogota Devnet 3 and how Frame transactions should support leanSPHINCS were pushed to next week.
